# fluxnova-bpm-platform

> FINOS Fluxnova BPM Platform 3.1.1 (LinkML)

## Agent context

If `.lokf/knowledge/index.md` exists in this repository, read it first. It is
a queryable [LOKF](https://lokf.nolan-nichols.com) knowledge bundle with
repository-specific context, conventions, and typed relationships that plain
prose cannot express. A concept marked `status: draft` has not yet been
confirmed by a person; one with a `human:` entry under `verified` has. Weigh
them accordingly.

The `ktl-docent` skill is the entry point for questions about this project.
Install it if it is not present, with the GitHub CLI (`gh skill install
noelmcloughlin/knowledge-trust-ladder ktl-docent --scope user --agent <yours>`)
or the Open Skills CLI (`npx skills add noelmcloughlin/knowledge-trust-ladder
--skill ktl-docent --yes`), which a company proxy or internal npm registry can
block; <https://w3id.org/ktl/docs/install/> has every route. Then answer
through it: bundle first, a trust label on every concept used, the source
opened for exact values, and misses recorded in `.lokf/feedback.md` so the
librarian fills them.

## Schema

The data model of this repository is a LinkML schema at
`.linkml/src/fluxnova_bpm_platform/schema/fluxnova_bpm_platform.yaml`,
also reachable as `linkml_schema/`. Read it before the code it
describes. Every class, field and enum is defined once there, and two
converters write its modules from FINOS's tree, so change a converter,
not a module. The JSON Schema, OWL and the rest under `.linkml/project/`
and the Pydantic models under
`.linkml/src/fluxnova_bpm_platform/datamodel/` are generated from it,
never edited. Change the schema through the `linkml-author` skill (`npx
skills add noelmcloughlin/linkml-sidecar --skill linkml-author --yes`),
and run `just --justfile .linkml/justfile lint` and `test` before
committing.

The `.lokf/` knowledge bundle validates its concepts against this schema
too (`lokf validate --schema`): a concept whose `type` names a class
defined here carries only the fields that class declares.
